title: Optimization Suggestions (Beta) — Feedback Intake Template
body:
Purpose
Use this template to capture consistent, actionable feedback from beta customers for the Console “Optimization suggestions” experience (batching + caching suggestions only). The goal is to (1) identify product gaps and confusing UX, (2) surface trust concerns about estimates/risk labels, and (3) route issues quickly to the right owner (Product / Eng / Applied ML / Support).

When to use
- After a demo or beta check-in call
- When Support receives a ticket referencing “Suggestions” estimates/risk/empty states
- When an internal stakeholder dogfoods the feature and sees confusing behavior

How to file
- Create a copy of this template per feedback item (not per account) when possible.
- If the feedback is urgent (production impact, data leakage concern, major estimate regression), ALSO open a Linear issue and link it below.


============================
1) Basic info
============================
Date:
Submitted by (name + team):
Customer / Org name:
Customer segment: (startup / mid-market / enterprise)
Deployment mode: (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private)
Region(s):
Console project/workspace (if applicable):
Beta flag enabled? (yes/no/unknown)
How feedback was received: (call / email / Slack / Support ticket / in-product)
Call/transcript link or ticket link (optional):
Primary contact role: (platform eng / ML eng / PM / finance / ops / other)


============================
2) What the customer was trying to do
============================
Task / job-to-be-done (one sentence):

Where they started (page/entry point):
- Suggestions page
- Route/model dashboard
- Alert / email
- Other:

What they expected to happen:

What actually happened:

Impact:
- Blocked (cannot proceed)
- Slowed down (confusing / extra steps)
- Low confidence (won’t apply changes)
- FYI / minor annoyance


============================
3) The feedback (verbatim + interpretation)
============================
Verbatim quote(s):

What we think they mean (interpretation):

Suggested follow-up question(s) to ask next time:
- 
- 


============================
4) Category (pick 1–2)
============================
Primary category:
- Confusing UI / unclear copy
- Missing functionality (filters, views, export)
- Savings estimate seems wrong / inflated / inconsistent
- Latency impact estimate seems wrong
- Risk level confusing or misleading
- Confidence/assumptions unclear
- Suggestion not actionable (no clear “how to enable”)
- Eligibility/empty state (insufficient telemetry)
- RBAC / permissions issue
- Performance issue (slow page/API)
- Other:

Secondary category (optional):


============================
5) Trust & clarity diagnostics (required)
============================
What specifically reduced trust? (check all that apply)
- Savings number feels too high / too low
- Savings not matching billing or cost reports
- Latency delta feels unrealistic
- Risk label doesn’t match our SLOs
- Risk label feels like “security risk” (misinterpretation)
- Assumptions are hidden / unclear
- Suggestion lacks evidence (“why are you recommending this?”)
- Feels like it could break reliability (timeouts / rate limits)
- Prior bad experience with batching/caching
- Other:

Which UI element triggered the concern?
- Savings ($/day or %) column
- Latency p50/p95 deltas
- Risk badge / tooltip
- Confidence / “based on X days of data” message
- Details drawer explanation
- “Stale as of” timestamp
- Empty state messaging
- Other:

Did the customer ask for a guarantee / commitment?
- No
- Yes (describe):

What did we tell them?
- Reiterated “estimates, not guarantees”
- Walked through assumptions
- Recommended canary/rollout approach
- Escalated to Support/CS
- Other:


============================
6) Repro details (as specific as possible)
============================
Suggestion type:
- Batching
- Caching

Route(s) affected:
Model(s) affected:
Traffic pattern notes (if known):
- High QPS vs spiky
- Typical prompt length / completion length
- Streaming on/off

Time window seen:
- Last 24h
- Last 7d
- Last 14d
- Unknown

Screenshots / screen recording link:
Console URL (if safe to share internally):

If “empty / insufficient telemetry”:
- Which empty state did they see (paste exact text):
- Customer claims traffic is high? (yes/no)
- Do they have telemetry enabled for the route? (yes/no/unknown)

If “RBAC / permissions”:
- User role:
- Error message:
- Org/project scope:


============================
7) Triage tags (for routing) — choose all that apply
============================
Severity:
- Sev0: potential security/tenancy issue
- Sev1: blocks adoption or causes major customer escalation
- Sev2: confusing but workaround exists
- Sev3: polish / nice-to-have

Where we think the fix lives:
- Console UI
- Suggestions API
- Estimation model (savings)
- Estimation model (latency)
- Risk scoring / thresholds
- Telemetry pipeline / data availability
- Documentation / in-product education
- RBAC/authz
- Not sure

Customer impact area:
- Cost / unit economics
- Latency SLOs
- Reliability / timeouts
- Quality (output correctness)
- Compliance / governance

Confidence in repro:
- High (consistent)
- Medium (intermittent)
- Low (one-off)

Suggested owner group (initial):
- Product (Optimize) — Aditya
- Product (Console) — Marissa
- Eng (Console & Tooling) — Dylan
- Backend (Console) — Chloe
- Telemetry — Logan/Nadia
- Applied ML / Optimize — Maya/Jonas
- Support readiness — Dev
- CS/Beta program — Miguel


============================
8) Proposed next step
============================
What we should do next (pick one):
- Ask follow-up questions (list them)
- Schedule technical deep-dive
- File Linear ticket
- Update docs/copy
- Add dashboard/alert/check
- Mark as known limitation (beta)

If filing work, include links:
- Linear issue:
- PRD/design link:
- Related Slack thread:

ETA expectation set with customer (if any):


============================
9) Notes for Support/CS (optional)
============================
Approved messaging / phrasing we used:

Anything we should avoid saying:

If customer escalates, who should be looped in:


============================
Appendix: quick tag glossary (keep consistent across submissions)
============================
- “Estimate accuracy”: customer disputes $/day, %, or thinks it conflicts with billing.
- “Risk label confusion”: customer interprets risk as security/compliance OR doesn’t understand what drives Low/Medium/High.
- “Not actionable”: customer sees a recommendation but can’t find the config surface / doesn’t have permissions / unclear steps.
- “Insufficient telemetry”: customer sees empty state due to missing data, lag, or pipeline issues.

Reminder: Beta scope boundaries
- Suggestions beta covers batching + caching only.
- We do not guarantee savings.
- We do not auto-apply changes; recommended path is review + rollout controls.
